mapper.sql: id, order_no, product_model, batch_no, planned_qty, completed_qty, production_line, status, delivery_date, create_by, remark, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mes_production_order (order_no, product_model, batch_no, planned_qty, completed_qty, production_line, status, delivery_date, create_by, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{productModel}, #{batchNo}, #{plannedQty}, #{completedQty}, #{productionLine}, #{status}, #{deliveryDate}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE mes_production_order
order_no = #{orderNo}, product_model = #{productModel}, batch_no = #{batchNo}, planned_qty = #{plannedQty}, completed_qty = #{completedQty}, production_line = #{productionLine}, status = #{status}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE mes_production_order SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mes_production_order WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(completed_qty) AS total_output FROM mes_production_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(completed_qty) AS output FROM mes_production_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
SELECT production_line AS name, SUM(completed_qty) AS value FROM mes_production_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY value DESC
